availability.note: lexus.com.au (model page and newsroom) returned HTTP 403 to fetches on 2026-11-26, so the configurator could not be read. EV Central's RX 450h+ page ('Pricing and specifications last updated 21 November 2026') lists exactly two grades, Luxury and Sports Luxury; CarsGuide's RX450h+ price page (https://www.carsguide.com.au/lexus/rx450h-/price, Glass's data) carries 2027 model-year entries spanning the same two grades; CarExpert (5 Dec 2025) and GoAuto (Jan 2026) give the same two-grade line-up. Matches the held count. Caveat: Lexus Australia said RX production at Miyata was suspended from 28 July 2026 after the Japan earthquake (CarsGuide, 31 Jul 2026); no later restart statement found.

listPrice.note: CarExpert 5 Dec 2025 MY26 price table: "priced at $105,350 before on-road costs"; GoAuto Jan 2026 (https://goauto.com.au/new-models/lexus/rx/phev/2026-01-05/98159.html) "plus on-road costs" / "Pricing excludes on-road costs" gives the same figure from Lexus's release table; carsales research (https://www.carsales.com.au/research/lexus/rx/2025/rx450h-plus-luxury/20c4166f-89f5-43da-8aa4-3b24ea79c39f/) 'price when new' agrees. Owner convention: manufacturer's price preferred. Conflict: CarsGuide/Glass's (MY2026 and MY2027) and EV Central (updated 21 Nov 2026, 'list and exclude on-road costs', marked 'price estimated') show $105,450, $100 higher; no Lexus announcement of a rise found and lexus.com.au was unreachable.

batteryKwh.note: 18.1 kWh is gross (Lexus UK tech spec "Capacity (kWh) 18.1", 96 cells; ADAC "Batteriekapazität (Brutto) 18,1"). Usable is unpublished; 16.0 kWh (~88%) judged, matching sibling lexus-nx-phev on the same 18.1 kWh pack.

rangeKm.note: ADAC catalogue, RX 450h+ (Modellstart 10/25) on 19-inch (235/60R19): "Reichweite WLTP (elektrisch) 67 km". The 19- and 21-inch EU entries both read 67 km, matching the AU Luxury (19-inch) and Sports Luxury (21-inch) wheels. Lexus AU's 85 km is NEDC (CarExpert: "on the NEDC cycle") and fails the direction test; Lexus EU's "up to 69 km" is a best case.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 16.0 / 67 x 100 = 23.9. ADAC's 12.2 kWh/100km '2. Antrieb' figure is utility-factor-weighted, a different quantity, and not used.

combinedRangeKm.note: WLTP electric 67 km + 55 L tank / 7.0 L/100km x 100 (785.7 km) = 852.7, rounded 853. Tank 55 L: ADAC "Tankgröße 55,0 l", Lexus UK tech spec, carsales AU research.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: ADAC 'Verbrauch kombiniert (WLTP) PHEV (Batterie leer) 7,0 l/100 km' (WLTP charge-sustaining). Corroborated by ADAC Autotest (Oct 2025) 7.1 L/100km battery-empty and EV Central's Australian test '6.5-7L/100km ... purely in that hybrid mode'. Replaces held 6.7 (US EPA hybrid-mode figure).

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: Australian ADR 81/02 combined label 1.3 L/100km (carsales research; CarExpert Dec 2025), below 3.5.

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green car = combined tailpipe CO2 of 120 g/km or less; AU label CO2 29 g/km (https://www.carsales.com.au/research/lexus/rx/2025/rx450h-plus-luxury/20c4166f-89f5-43da-8aa4-3b24ea79c39f/).

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: Lexus UK tech spec 'Rear seats up, loaded to tonneau cover' (VDA) 461 L, per the owner's cargo-cover convention; 612 L in the same table is 'loaded to roof', the figure Lexus AU and CarsGuide quote. ADAC 'Kofferraumvolumen normal 461 l'. Held 612 was the to-roof figure.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: ADAC 'Kofferraumvolumen dachhoch mit umgeklappter Rücksitzbank 1678 l': to the roof. No belt-line folded figure published; to-roof folded matches sibling mazda-cx-80-phev's basis.

seats.note: carsales research: 5 seats; Lexus UK tech spec seating capacity 5.

towKg.note: carsales research (AU spec): braked towing 1,500 kg; CarExpert 2026 RX review and CarsGuide spec page also 1500 kg. The EU rating is 2,000 kg (Lexus UK tech spec); the AU rating is used.

warrantyYears.note: carsales research: 5 years from first registration, unlimited km. Unconditional.

insuranceAnnual.note: Held judgement kept (price unchanged). Anchors: mercedes-glc-phev $99,900 -> $2,500; lexus-nx-phev F Sport $96,000 -> $2,350; volvo-xc90-phev Plus T8 $120,990 -> $2,700.

depreciationCurve.note: Owner convention: one curve per brand, all Lexus rows on one curve. Mainstream default chosen as the Lexus curve: held RX rows (0.74/0.72 at year 1), lexus-nx-phev (0.77/0.75) and lexus-rz (0.68-0.65) were all on different curves. Evidence against a steeper curve: carsales private-buy guide for a 2025 RX450h+ Luxury $92,900-96,100 against $105,350 new. lexus-nx-phev and lexus-rz need aligning to the same curve.
